findings.message: F1 (sources governance, run 001) - RESOLVED by commit a7200d2 and verified this run: specs/content/gict-300/sources/unit-05.md's purdueOwl declaration no longer claims corroboration by the bourgeois2019 chapter 12 excerpt; it now honestly states the two-part honest-use habit rests on the directly read page (2026-09-23) and the unit's own workflow, not on any bound excerpt, under D-2026-0001. The declaration is honest and complete; the prose claim stays within it.

F2 (attribution gap, carried forward from run 001, unchanged bytes): docs/semester-1/gict-300/unit-05/topic-01.mdx, "Digital citizenship and its dimensions", teaches the respect/educate/protect dimensions taxonomy as "the commonly taught dimensions" without attribution; no bound source carries this taxonomy (digcomp2022 is scoped in sources/unit-05.md to the competence-side view; the commonsenseDC declaration covers its six topic areas only). Nothing is misattributed, but naming the framework or binding a source for it would strengthen the unit.

F3 (uncorroborated parenthetical, carried forward from run 001, unchanged bytes): docs/semester-1/gict-300/unit-05/topic-03.mdx, "Intellectual property rights": the parenthetical "(though registration is needed to sue in some jurisdictions)" is hedged and factually correct but carried by no bound source and unattributed; the bound bourgeois2019 excerpt supports only automatic arrival on creation. Consider citing a source or dropping the parenthetical.

F4 (Bloom label, run 001) - RESOLVED by commit a7200d2 and verified this run: unit-assessment.mdx ERQ-2 is now tagged (Analyze) in both the item and its rubric, matching the thinking actually required and topic-02.mdx's own summative marking guide; the blueprint's Evaluate band remains satisfied by ERQ-5; check:bloom-bands passes over the whole corpus (375 items).

F5 (marking vocabulary, run 001) - RESOLVED by commit a7200d2 and verified this run: unit-assessment.mdx RRQ-10's model answer now names "copying with small changes (the structure and ideas kept, only words swapped)", the exact form vocabulary topic-03.mdx teaches, so a correct answer in the unit's own words fully earns the "1 for the form" mark.

F6 (misconception placement, carried forward from run 001, unchanged bytes): two of the four spec-listed misconceptions (specs/content/gict-300/content-spec.md ## Unit 5: "if it is on the internet, it is free to use" and "copyright applies only to books and music") are addressed only through the opening story, the Bourgeois copyright quote (which includes computer programs) and the teacher notes, rather than named-and-corrected in topic Explanation sections as the other two are.

F7 (link text, carried forward from run 001, re-observed this run): the three topics' Further reading lists (topic-01.mdx, topic-02.mdx, topic-03.mdx) use bare URLs as link text (3-4 per topic), reported as advisory by render-inspect; descriptive link text would improve screen-reader flow. Same pattern was left as advisory in the Unit 1 G3 run and in run 001.

The manifest was prepared at commit e12079a over the current bytes; all 97 input digests were recomputed with manifestFor() at HEAD 0f8e97d and match exactly (the two commits between e12079a and HEAD touch only Unit 4 files and review/tracker artifacts, which are unit-scoped or excluded from binding).

F9 (NEW, bundle/governance, no content change required): specs/content/gict-300/sources/unit-05.md's wipoIP entry says "bound excerpt in sources/texts/wipoIP.md", but that file is NOT in this review's input manifest: the citation-key scope in scripts/lib/review-evidence.mjs (citedKeysFor) binds sources/texts/<key>.md only for keys matching a year-suffix pattern, and "wipoIP" does not match, so no unit's review ever binds it. The excerpt exists at the declared path and does support the single WIPO framing sentence in topic-03.mdx (inspected this run; copy saved as logs-20260924T020159051Z/wipoIP-excerpt-inspected.md), and every substantive IP fact rests on the bound bourgeois2019 excerpt, so sources still pass; but the word "bound" overstates the manifest protection, and an edit to wipoIP.md after this review would not invalidate it. Recommend extending the key pattern to the non-year key family or rewording the table cell.
